status: frozen before empirical fitting; constants provisional and uncalibrated on real papers
data_regime: different_vintage: independently acquired nflverse play-by-play (2025-2026 builds) versus an unnamed source used by the authors; the realised sample can differ from the published one

implementation_agreement.compare_first: sample hash, N, and origin estimates of all three implementations, before any target comparison
implementation_agreement.scope: origin M1-M3 coefficients, SEs, LL and ME0 margins; grid cells compared for dispersion only
implementation_agreement.rule: two of three agreeing permits scoring on that pair (the lowest implementation letter of the pair supplies values); the third goes to code audit; no agreeing pair gives indeterminate/implementation_disagreement

rounding.odds_ratio: printed to 3 decimals: interval [v-0.0005, v+0.0005], mapped to the log-odds interval [ln(lo), ln(hi)]
rounding.odds_ratio_se: printed to 3 decimals; log-scale SE upper bound = (s+0.0005)/lo, where lo is the lower end of the OR interval; a printed 0.000 uses 0.0005/lo and is flagged low_resolution
rounding.marginal_effect: printed to 4 decimals: interval [v-0.00005, v+0.00005]; SE upper bound s+0.00005; printed 0.0000 flagged low_resolution
rounding.se_scale_assumption: Table 5 parenthesised values are treated as delta-method SEs of the odds ratio (both readers' reading; not stated in the article)

sign.assessable_if: the published interval excludes the null (OR 1 / log-odds 0; ME 0)
sign.mismatch_if: assessable and the reconstructed point estimate lies strictly on the other side of the null

inference.tail: two-sided (article does not state the tail; the stated software reports two-sided tests by default)
inference.consistent_if: band difference <= 1, or the reconstructed band is stronger than a published significant band (published band 1-3)
inference.discrepant_candidate_if: band difference >= 2 in the weakening direction for a published significant target, or >= 2 in either direction for a published nonsignificant target (band 4)
inference.benchmark: cluster-robust by game on the paired U7=1 fit (grid.json); fragile_inference if native inference is consistent but the benchmark band is >= 2 bands weaker than the published band

magnitude.statistic: delta_se = distance from the reconstructed estimate to the published rounding interval (0 inside), divided by the published SE upper bound on the same scale

N.evaluated_by_code: relative difference of the origin N from the published analysis N, and step-wise flow comparisons
N.effect: N is not itself a claim criterion; if large, any non-consistent target outcome becomes indeterminate/source_vintage instead of discrepant_candidate

target_outcome.consistent: sign ok or not assessable, inference consistent, magnitude consistent or not audited (if magnitude is not audited, outcome is consistent_partial_criteria)
target_outcome.grey: no discrepant criterion and magnitude grey
target_outcome.discrepant_candidate: any of sign mismatch, inference discrepant_candidate, magnitude discrepant_candidate

claim_rule: all primary targets consistent (native) -> consistent; if any primary target is fragile_inference -> fragile_inference

any primary target discrepant_candidate at origin -> check every uncertain branch (individual deviations and crossings): if the claim's primary targets are all consistent in any uncertain branch -> indeterminate/label_sensitive; otherwise discrepant_candidate (requires adversarial review before a final discrepant verdict; withheld as fully verified because no independent model family is available)
large N difference converts discrepant_candidate to indeterminate/source_vintage
claims.secondary_reporting: Table 6 marginal effects are scored target by target with the same criteria and reported as shares (consistent / grey / discrepant_candidate / not assessable) qualifying the claim; they do not change the claim outcome
claims.fragile: not assessed: the substantive equivalent set is empty after reconciliation
claims.nonfocal: nuisance-control odds ratios (Table 5) are scored target by target and reported; fit statistics (LL, LR chi2) are publication diagnostics only because the realised samples differ and the printed incremental chi-squares are internally inconsistent

paper_aggregation.focal_structure: four focal hypotheses H1A, H1B, H2, H3 (both readers mark all four focal); H2 and H3 carry the article's central moderation claim (title and abstract)
rule: any focal claim indeterminate or not attemptable -> paper indeterminate (with that claim's sub-code)
all four consistent -> paper consistent; fully reproduced if no lower-tier target is discrepant_candidate, otherwise partially reproduced
H2 or H3 discrepant (after adversarial review) -> not reproduced
only H1A and/or H1B discrepant -> partially reproduced
fragile_inference on any focal claim with the rest consistent -> fragile inference (reported as such, not mapped to the reproduced categories)
unconfirmed discrepant candidates keep the paper at indeterminate/pending_confirmation

influence: reported as ranges; never enter the claim outcome
compute_budget: grid.json in full; influence per decisions_v1.md
calibration_status: provisional; scorer is to be tested on synthetic cases (planted errors, unreachable targets, null data) before scoring; no real-paper calibration exists in this session
